name: Mesh Solidify
description: Rebuild a broken mesh body (holes, open shells, overlaps) as one watertight, printable solid. Adds the result as a new body.

body.title: Body
body.description: Mesh body to rebuild. Empty uses the selected body.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: Uniform scale for the result: 0.1 is 10%.

voxel.title: Detail (mm)
voxel.description: Grid spacing in output mm. 0 picks the finest that fits the voxel budget.

min_feature.title: Thicken (mm)
min_feature.description: Offset the surface outward so thin parts survive slicing.

iso.title: Fill threshold
iso.description: Winding-number threshold for inside. Lower fills more.

target_faces.title: Triangles
target_faces.description: Output triangle budget (SolidCraft 0.41 accepts about 30,000 from a plugin).

fair_tau.title: Patch smoothing
fair_tau.description: Vertices farther than this many voxels from the input are hole patches and get smoothed. 0 turns it off.

fair_grow.title: Smoothing rings
fair_grow.description: Extra rings smoothed around each patch.

max_voxels.title: Voxel budget
max_voxels.description: Largest grid when Detail is 0. More is finer but slower; SolidCraft 0.41 stops a plugin after a fixed amount of work, about 2,000,000 here.

body.title: Body
body.description: Mesh body to check. Empty uses the selected body.
